articles.title: South Africa Dominates Inaugural Sunshine Rwanda Open Golf
articles.summary: KIGALI — South African golfers dominated the inaugural Rwanda Open, with Kyle de Beer claiming his first Sunshine Tour title by six strokes at Kigali Golf Resort & Villas on Sunday.… The post South Africa Dominates Inaugural Sunshine Rwanda Open Golf appeared first on KT PRESS .
